name: Clove Cakes
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: fine brown sugar
ingredients.originalText: a pound of fine brown sugar

ingredients.name: half an ounce of cloves ground or powdered
ingredients.originalText: half an ounce of cloves ground or powdered
ingredients.quantityText: half an ounce of cloves ground or powdered

instructions.text: Rub a pound of fresh butter (cut up) into three pounds of sifted flour
Add by degrees a pound of fine brown sugar, half an ounce of cloves ground or powdered, and sufficient West India molasses to wet the whole into a stiff dough
Dissolve a small tea-spoonful of sal-aratus in tepid water and mix in at the last
Roll the dough out into a sheet of paste
Cut out the cakes with a tin stamp, or with the edge of a tumbler
Bake them a quarter of an hour or more

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Rub a pound of fresh butter (cut up) into three pounds of sifted flour
2. Add by degrees a pound of fine brown sugar, half an ounce of cloves ground or powdered, and sufficient West India molasses to wet the whole into a stiff dough
3. Dissolve a small tea-spoonful of sal-aratus in tepid water and mix in at the last
4. Roll the dough out into a sheet of paste
5. Cut out the cakes with a tin stamp, or with the edge of a tumbler
6. Put them in buttered pans
7. Bake them a quarter of an hour or more

half an ounce of cloves ground or powdered
